intro: A sample of this week's ledger, showing the new format: plain-English write-ups, a map with the search area marked, and an update on where the forest's grazing cattle are.

findings.title: The Hair of the Dog
findings.status_label: New, not yet on the map
findings.body: A new pub-restaurant has opened on York Hill in Loughton. It's not yet shown on the map — worth a quick look before it's added, since a couple of directories describe it slightly differently (Italian restaurant vs. pub).

findings.title: La Sala
findings.status_label: New, not yet on the map
findings.body: Trade press reports a new restaurant, La Sala, has opened in Woodford Green. It's not yet shown on the map.

findings.title: Zizzi
findings.body: This branch has closed and has been taken off the map. A separate Zizzi in South Woodford is still open and hasn't been touched.

findings.title: Morrisons Café
findings.body: The in-store café at the Loughton Morrisons looks to have closed, though the supermarket itself is still trading. Worth a phone check before the map is updated.

findings.title: Bakers Lane, Epping
findings.body: Closing for around 16 weeks for resurfacing ahead of the new Epping Leisure Centre. Diversions are signed, and pavements and nearby car parks stay open throughout.

findings.title: Skylark Conservation Event
findings.body: A free conservation event at the Harrow Road Pavilion — no booking required.

grazing.body: The forest's grazing cattle have moved to a new paddock near High Beach, on the eastern side of the forest.
